single_adjacent_change.name: Finalized Sparse-Clock Torsion
single_adjacent_change.problem: Stage85 required the current and two immediately preceding five-minute decisions all to contain an exact elapsed-time 48-bar horizon. Real maintenance and weekend gaps made 86 raw turns context-ineligible without saying anything about their morphology.
single_adjacent_change.law: At each exact V18 raw turn, retain the current exact four-hour observation and the two most recent earlier exact four-hour observations from the same contract. Never synthesize an observation for a missing five-minute decision.
single_adjacent_change.slope_rate: difference in exact 48-horizon slope_pct_per_bar divided by actual elapsed hours between finalized observations
single_adjacent_change.slope_acceleration: current slope rate minus prior slope rate
single_adjacent_change.tr_rate: difference in exact 48-horizon tr_mean_pct divided by actual elapsed hours
single_adjacent_change.tr_acceleration: current TR rate minus prior TR rate
single_adjacent_change.age_evidence: record both actual elapsed gaps in minutes; no hidden cap, interpolation, weekend reset, or age-selected subset
single_adjacent_change.incumbent_age_correction: liquidity-elasticity uses the immediately preceding V18 decision's state_age_bars, because the raw-turn snapshot has already reset its age and cannot describe the incumbent trend

unchanged: all 1493 exact V18 raw turns and 338 admissions
raw direction, proposal, one-bar maturation, route, and risk reduction
five-minute TR/path, fifteen-minute curvature, thirty-minute basis, strictly prior five-session context, and causal news laws
all five frozen eclectic families and sign categories
primary prospective V84 gate of 30 complete turns, 10 each direction, 20 admissions, and 5 each admitted route
no outcomes, controls, classifier, action, order, or capital authority

count_gate.route_floor_note: The frozen 20-route floor is retained even though Stage85 revealed only 18 validation continuation admissions. Sparse-clock success cannot erase that independent near-miss.

outcome_boundary: Count and morphology only. A pass may make the sparse clock the prospective context owner, but cannot open historical or prospective economics. V84 unseen event treatments and matched controls remain mandatory.
prohibitions: no carried price, invented bar, interpolation, gap cap, time-bin sweep, or context abstention
no lowering the 95 percent Stage85 law or 20-route floor after counts
no direct slow direction, static consensus, entry veto, exit, sizing, order, capital, or crown authority
no PnL, return, MFE, MAE, winner, threshold, or category-union exposure
